notes: Taken from the Board of Elections' 46-day election notice, which lists every contest and issue with the precincts that vote on it, checked against the Board's sample ballots for all 87 precinct splits (which give the full ballot wording).

Candidates are listed alphabetically by last name, not in ballot order: Ohio rotates the order of names from precinct to precinct. Certified write-in candidates are not printed on the ballot and are not listed.

"Where you live" uses the state voter file: a district or school levy is shown for a city, village or township when any of its voters live in that district. Your exact ballot depends on your precinct.
The Board's notice and sample ballots do not give local issue numbers.

issues.title: Charter amendment (by petition): new Section 4.03, referendum petitions
issues.text: Shall Article IV, Section 4.03 of the Charter of the City of Marysville be enacted as follows: Section 4.03 Referendum Petition. The electors reserve to themselves the powers of initiative and referendum to the extent permitted and by the procedure provided by this Charter and the Law and Constitution of Ohio. Notwithstanding any other provision of this Charter or Ohio Law, whoever files a referendum petition regarding any proposed ordinance or measure shall not be required to file a certified copy of the proposed ordinance or measure with the Director of Finance, or any person performing the function of city auditor for the municipality, before circulating such petition. Notwithstanding any other provision of this Charter or Ohio law, a referendum petition must be signed by ten percent of the number of electors in the city who voted for governor in the most recent general election for the office of governor in the municipal corporation and must be filed with the Director of Finance.
